scope: Named Riga bar/pub/biergarten/nightclub records from inventory/riga-venues.json that are not represented by the same venue in app/venues.ts. Delivery feeds were used only as discovery evidence and never as price evidence.

venues.name: A'Drop
venues.reason: Official site was reachable but no current beer menu with explicit venue prices was exposed. Do not use delivery prices.

venues.name: Alus rūme Trofeja
venues.reason: Official site identifies the brewery/pub and products but does not publish a current tap list with serving sizes and on-site prices. Wolt menu was checked only for discovery; its prices were excluded as delivery prices.

venues.name: Andalūzijas suns
venues.reason: The current official menu landing page exposes drink-menu images, but the only machine-readable beer PDF found is an old menu (source crawl ~2020). It is not safe to display as a current 2026 price list without a fresh in-venue image or current menu export.

venues.name: Angārs Bārs
venues.reason: Official page links to a drinks menu but does not expose readable current beer names, volumes and venue prices in fetched content.

venues.name: Aussie Pub
venues.reason: Official site was checked, but no publicly readable current beer menu with explicit serving sizes and prices was available.

venues.name: Beer Museum
venues.reason: Official current page publishes a Draft beer list and beer specifications, but no serving sizes or prices. Names are retained as discovery evidence only; no prices were inferred.

venues.name: BEERloga
venues.reason: Official site is only a landing page; the linked online menu is not a Riga venue-price source with reliably current EUR beer rows. Delivery listings were not used for prices.

venues.name: Black Magic
venues.reason: Official site focuses on chocolate, cocktails and spirits; no current beer-price rows were exposed.

venues.name: Bruklinas krogs un viskija bārs
venues.reason: Official site did not expose a machine-readable current beer menu with explicit serving sizes and venue prices.

venues.name: Brūzis Manufaktūra
venues.evidenceNotes: Official menu page crawled last month. It explicitly labels the bottled rows as 'Uz vietas' (on site) €5.00 per 0.5 L and separately lists 300/500 ml non-alcoholic prices. The generic 'Jebkurš lejamais alus' row has no beer name, so it was not added as a named beer.

venues.name: Cabo cafe
venues.evidenceNotes: Official drinks page was crawled four weeks ago and explicitly lists eight draft beers with 330/500 ml venue prices. The separate 2026 PDF exists but its text is not exposed; the current HTML menu is used.

venues.name: Craft Beer Station
venues.reason: Official site confirms 12 taps and a large bottle/can selection but does not publish a current named tap list or prices.

venues.name: Distillers Republic
venues.reason: Official site confirms draft/craft beer but exposes no current beer names, serving sizes and venue prices.

venues.name: DJ bārs
venues.reason: No publicly readable current beer menu with explicit venue prices was found on the official site.

venues.name: Fenikss
venues.reason: Official site does not expose a current beer menu with explicit serving sizes and on-site prices.

venues.name: Folkklubs Ala Pagrabs
venues.reason: Official current page contains beer-snack and food prices but no beer names, serving sizes and venue prices. Do not turn the 'beer platter' or free-beer promotion into beer-price data.

venues.name: Klubs Depo
venues.reason: Official site publishes events and venue information but no current beer menu/prices.

venues.name: Labietis
venues.sourceType: current public Untappd venue tap list
venues.reason: Untappd page crawled in the current week and exposes today's 16 tap names/volumes but no prices. Labietis webshop prices are retail/take-away, not on-site prices, so they were excluded.

venues.name: Laska V21
venues.reason: Official Wix site and public social link were checked, but no current readable venue beer menu/prices were exposed.

venues.name: Möku Riga
venues.reason: Official brand site does not expose a Riga-specific current beer menu with venue prices; third-party menu pages are not sufficient evidence.

venues.name: Nurme
venues.reason: Official site identifies the brewery but does not publish a current Avotu bar tap list with on-site serving prices.

venues.name: Sapņi un kokteiļi
venues.reason: Official nightclub site does not expose a current beer menu with explicit venue prices.

venues.name: Sveiks, Švejk!
venues.reason: Official PDF is dated August 2025 and therefore not safe to present as current 2026 venue pricing without a fresh menu confirmation.

venues.name: Top
venues.reason: Official nightclub site has no publicly readable current beer menu/prices.

venues.name: Victory Pub
venues.reason: Official drinks page was reachable but does not expose readable current beer names, sizes and venue prices in fetched content.
